voiceover: You push your code. It works perfectly. Then your teammate runs it and everything breaks. Different node version. A missing environment variable. A file that only exists on your laptop. Your machine is not the world. It's one very specific, very messy computer. So when someone says it doesn't work for them, believe them, and ask what they're running. Same bug, different machine. Send this to the dev who always says it works on mine.
